description_en: Queries the configurations, including time variables, of a specified task node based on the task node ID
description_zh: 调用GetTask接口，按照任务流节点ID获取指定节点的配置，包括任务的时间变量
name: GetTask

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

: To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task node. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424711.html operation to query the node ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务节点ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424711.html接口获取此参数的值
parameters.name: node_id

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to query logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败

DagId.description_en: The ID of the task flow to which the node belongs

GraphParam.description_en: The position of the node on the Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)
GraphParam.description_zh: 节点在图上的显示位置

NodeOutput.description_en: The output variables for the node. This parameter is available only for some types of nodes
NodeOutput.description_zh: 节点输出变量，仅部分类型节点存在此参数

NodeType.description_en: The type of the node. For more information about the valid values for this parameter, see [NodeType parameter]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424705.html）
NodeType.description_zh: 任务节点类型，返回值请参见[NodeType参数说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424705.html）

TimeVariables.description_zh: 节点变量（时间变量配置）
